extracted.name: Spinach smoothie
extracted.description: Whizz up our spinach smoothie with avocado, sweet mango and milk in minutes. If you have leftovers, try freezing them in lolly moulds for an easy dessert
ingredient_lines: 2 chunks frozen spinach (or 2 handfuls fresh baby spinach)
instruction_lines: Whizz the frozen spinach with the avocado, chopped mango, banana and milk (we used unsweetened oat milk) in a powerful blender until smooth. Freeze the leftovers in lolly moulds for desserts, if you like.
